description: A0 structure detection and routing dataset manifest
label_notes: A0 is the entry gatekeeper. It detects supported oil palm structures and proposes bbox candidates for user confirmation. It does not predict FFB maturity, Ganoderma risk, or growth status. 'unknown' is not a YOLO class; images without supported structures should be kept as negative/empty-label samples and surfaced by inference as route_status=no_supported_structure_detected or uncertain.

split_strategy.constraint: Images from the same source dataset, session, video, plantation, block, or tree should stay in the same split
split_strategy.notes: A0 data may be bootstrapped from existing task datasets by drawing structure bboxes. Empty-label negative samples should stay in the same grouped split as their source context.

notes: A0 model is the structure-detection routing gatekeeper, not a production predictor
Training data can be bootstrapped from other task datasets by adding fruit_bunch, trunk_base, and crown_region bboxes
Do not train an unknown bbox class; use empty-label negatives for unsupported content
This manifest will evolve as dedicated A0 datasets are collected
